meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把杂乱难懂的代码拆解重组成清晰结构,让它更易读易改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有写乱或过时的代码想理清结构又不想改变行为
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code into a clearer structure without changing what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your code feels tangled and you want cleaner structure without behavior changes

howto.what: 当你要求重构代码时,Claude 会先确认目标,再并行分析代码库、画出依赖与影响范围、评估测试覆盖,生成分步计划后逐步改写,每改一步就跑测试和类型检查。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化或抽取代码时接管,也可用 /refactor 命令指定目标和范围。

say.text: 帮我把 AuthService 类里的参数校验逻辑抽成单独模块
say.note: 它会先复述理解、确认后再分析代码库。

say.text: 重构 util 目录,把重复的日期处理函数合并

howto.what_en: When you refactor code, Claude confirms the goal, maps the codebase and dependencies, checks test coverage, plans steps, then edits step by step, running tests and type checks after each change.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, or extract code, or via /refactor with a target and scope.

say_en.note: Refactors only that file; safe strategy by default.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in the AuthService class into its own module
say_en.note: It confirms understanding first, then analyzes the codebase.

say_en.text: Refactor the util directory and merge duplicate date helpers
